svg.title: An approaching degenerate neckpinch at three times
svg.desc: An original asymptotic schematic of the odd cubic Angenent–Velázquez construction in three-space. The left tip approaches the origin at three illustrative times; the last panel is a cusp target. All panels use one equal-axis spatial scale. The compact slices are not numerical MCF solutions. Their tip caps use a numerical bowl ODE, with designed joins and outer caps.

g.text: One tip sharpens as t approaches T
n = 2 · m = 3 · K = 1 · common spatial scale · asymptotic schematic
The moving left tip (gold) approaches the cusp; the outer cap persists.
AV97, pp. 16–25. Designed compact slices; only the limiting bowl is ODE-integrated.
